session_summary: Blue title bar: 'Bear Trend From The Open, Then Reversal Up'. Reading: an opening bull trap at 5270 fails and a bear trend from the open grinds under the parabolic magenta dotted lines to the 5207 low; the wedge bottom became a V-bottom reversal, a higher-low bull channel walks under the dotted trend line for the whole afternoon, and a strong end-of-month breakout blows through the 5270 high-of-day line into a 5305 shaded-box close. trend_reversal_to_bull (open bear trend reversed at the low; strong close).
